source.kind: Wayback Machine capture of the site-internal catalog JSON (Category=2 / Subcategory=2 = Collectibles query)
source.retrievedVia: fetch_page, all 7 of 7 chunks read; transcribed by hand from the JSON text - re-verify against the capture before relying on any single field
source.gradeNote: Captured 2015-06-16, about 5.5 weeks before the 2015-07-23 target build. Prices are as listed then ("" price = off sale / limited reseller item; stored as null). The capture is a Collectibles query, so it contains limited items only.
source.completeness: All 7 chunks read; 42 items transcribed. Items split by chunk boundaries were re-joined from the overlapping fetches (Green Sidewinder, DIY Dominus Empyreus, Jade Katana, Sparkle Time Lump of Coal). Chunk 2's first record begins mid-item (its head sits in the unread tail of chunk 1's overlap) and one Gear record there could not be identified, so it is NOT included; the total in the capture is therefore not certain.

notCovered: Thumbnails (t*.rbxcdn.com hashes are in the capture, e.g. Green Sidewinder t5.rbxcdn.com/0acfc041e005c7eb89e5112500a97a9b; not retrieved, not recorded per item) and asset content are MISSING. Blackvalk (124730194) also appears in the 2015-03-09 capture with a 1,000,000 Tix price; this later capture shows it Limited/off sale and, because seeding loads captures in name order, this later record supersedes the earlier one. Fields privateSales/bestPrice/remaining were not recorded for the first 20 items.
